Title: Links reversed in tournament rules section

Messages.Author: Bloodartist
Messages.Body:
I was reading through tournament rules as my first tournament is approaching, and I noticed that the links "prev" and "next" on the bottom of each page at tournament rules section are reversed. Ie. prev is next and vice versa.  First page has only 'prev' and so on.

ps. While writing this post I noticed that "link" button in post editor menu is screwed and actually inserts world map into the post in addition to the link, lol xD
